not_found.reason: No reliable published vertical height for the exact full-size generation (database footprint 3.26 x 4.50). Equipboard reports 1.90in with a matching footprint, while Guitar Center's mislabeled 'Mini Katana' open-box page lists 2.28in with full-size proportions; no manufacturer/Sweetwater/reputable-dealer tie-breaker found.

Exact database key is V1 (footprint 2.64 x 5.15). Keeley's own published specs (via Soundpure) give only face-forward width/height 2.62in x 4.82in, not vertical Z height. Published 1.96in/50mm specs belong to Caverns V2 and must not be assigned to V1.
